name: Disaster Recovery
description: Disaster Recovery standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-DR applies.

rules.title: Define RTO and RPO for critical services
rules.detail: Business owners approve maximum recovery time and data loss objectives that drive architecture and backup choices.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define RTO and RPO for critical services.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define RTO and RPO for critical services.

rules.title: Document service dependencies and recovery order
rules.detail: Recovery plans identify DNS/network, identity, secrets, databases, queues, storage and application ordering.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Document service dependencies and recovery order.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Document service dependencies and recovery order.

rules.title: Maintain recovery capability outside the primary failure domain
rules.detail: Critical backups/configuration/runbooks and required credentials are available when the primary region/account/system is unavailable.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Maintain recovery capability outside the primary failure domain.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Maintain recovery capability outside the primary failure domain.

rules.title: Exercise disaster recovery scenarios
rules.detail: Run scheduled tabletop and technical recovery tests and record actual recovery time/data loss against objectives.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Exercise disaster recovery scenarios.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Exercise disaster recovery scenarios.

rules.title: Define failover and failback behavior
rules.detail: Document traffic cutover, data consistency, split-brain prevention and safe return to normal operation.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define failover and failback behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define failover and failback behavior.

rules.title: Update DR plans after material architecture changes
rules.detail: New dependencies, regions, data stores or identity systems trigger recovery-plan review.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Update DR plans after material architecture changes.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Update DR plans after material architecture changes.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-DR applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Disaster Recovery to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Disaster Recovery is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Disaster Recovery failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
